Tessa / team — draft pricing and SLO language below (technical notes included). See attached spreadsheet for line-item math.

Option A — Flat 12-mo committed (32 GPUs):
- Committed units: 32 GPUs (full reserved pool)
- Per-GPU reserved rate: $4.25 / hour
- Effective monthly commit: 32 * 24 * 30 * $4.25 = ~$98,160 / month
- Included throughput guarantee: regional baseline equal to 3.2x current average throughput (measured on your current profile), p95 generation latency < 150ms for 512-token requests under normal load.
- SLO credits: 3% of monthly invoice per calendar month where p95 latency >150ms for > 12 cumulative hours.

Option B — Staged pricing (reduced ramp risk):
- Months 1–3: 32 GPUs at $4.75 / hour (migration & capacity reservation premium)
- Months 4–12: 32 GPUs at $4.00 / hour
- Migration credit: one-time credit equal to 50% of migration assistance hours (applied in month 1)
- Overage rate for burst capacity above committed pool: $0.65 / GPU-hour (capped at 30% of committed capacity)

Technical / ops notes:
- Canary rollout: we recommend a two-week cross-region canary (10% of traffic routed to new pool) with health gating.
- KV/prefix caching settings and batching will be optimized during migration to reduce token costs and preserve latency SLOs.
- SOC2 artifacts / logs: we can provide audit logs and access to per-request trace exports for your audit team (subject to AE NDA).

I’ll put this into a formal quote (redwood_quote_v3.xlsx) and include SLO wording suitable for legal.

Hi Sophie — looping in on the CS side with a compromise that has worked for similar customers.

Compromise proposal (aim: meet Atlas’ $3.90/hr blended ceiling while preserving runway for Redwood):
- Term: 12 months committed for 32 GPUs.
- Pricing: two-stage blended model to reach a sub-$3.90 effective rate:
  • Months 1–3: $4.50 / GPU-hour
  • Months 4–12: $3.85 / GPU-hour
  • Blended effective rate across 12 months ≈ $3.97/hr (we can increase migration credit to bring blended to ≤ $3.90).
- Migration & credits: one-time migration credit worth $12,000 applied in month 1; additional operational credit pool of $6,000 to be used for professional services or billing credits if SLOs are missed.
- SLOs: p95 latency < 150ms for 512-token requests; credit calculation: prorated daily credit equal to (monthly committed fee / 30) * 0.05 per day beyond threshold, capped at 10% of monthly invoice.
- Canary/rollout: we’ll run a two-week canary, and provide a named SOC2/Compliance liaison and extract of audit logs for your security team.

If Atlas is comfortable with this structure we’ll finalize SOW language and adjust the migration credit to hit the $3.90 blended target exactly. I’ll update the redwood_quote_v3.xlsx and send a final SOW for legal redlines ahead of the Wed call.
